en.title: Keep cognitive demands within an acceptable range
en.subtitle: Interfaces, materials, workflows and model assistance shape what the person must do
sources: What should I learn to do?
en.focusTitle: Allocate by the capability being developed
en.focus: Scaffold the chosen practice; offload supporting work and avoidable coordination.
en.outcome: Usable results · sustainable effort · selected capability development
en.detail: Judge these separately, including the cost of instructions, checking and recovery.
en.return: Actual use revises the division of work and how it is chosen
en.description: Control the cognitive complexity of the whole environment within a personally acceptable range. The selected developmental goal determines which operations the person practices and which supporting operations the model handles. Assistance scaffolds practice when needed. Results, total burden and selected capability development are evaluated separately; their outcomes revise both the division and its design method.

zh-CN.title: 把环境的认知要求控制在可接受范围内
zh-CN.subtitle: 界面、资料、工作流程与模型辅助，共同决定本人需要处理什么
sources: 检索、组织、形式化与实现
恢复上下文、执行与核验
zh-CN.focusTitle: 分界跟随要培养的能力而改变
zh-CN.focus: 为目标练习提供适当辅助，把外围工作和多余协调交给模型。
zh-CN.outcome: 成果可用 · 总负担可接受 · 选定能力得到锻炼
zh-CN.detail: 分别检查三项结果，把交代、核验和恢复的成本一起算入。
zh-CN.return: 实际使用返回，改进分工与选择分工的方法
zh-CN.description: 把整个环境的认知复杂性控制在本人可接受的范围内。选定的培养目标决定本人练习哪些认知操作、模型承担哪些支持工作，必要辅助使练习能够展开。分别判断成果、总负担与选定能力的发展，再用结果修订分工以及形成这项分工的方法。
